summary: native-frontend-orb preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares preinstall=`node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from GitHub releases, extracts it to a tempdir, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync to run a shipped 727KB payload `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a Bun-cjs bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` marker) with hex-mangled identifiers and a large rotated string-array dispatcher — a format that cannot execute or be introspected under Node. The package advertises itself as a CircleCI orb aggregator (README and repo `ornikar/orb-frontend-native` describe CI helpers/YAML in src/), and the declared `main: index.js` is absent from the tarball, so the package has no library surface; the only effect of installing it is the preinstall drop-and-execute of the Bun-only obfuscated payload. The cover-story mismatch (CircleCI orb aggregator has no need for a Bun runtime), the alternate-runtime choice specifically evading Node-based supply-chain scanners, and the heavy obfuscation of the executed payload together establish an install-time remote code execution against the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
